input_strings: packet id/state and channel id/reactant states/data/kernel hashes, content bytes
candidate_strings: five copied strings plus five terminators per row; logical payload, not allocator overhead
pair_budget: every co-cell pair, including no matching channel; tested before kinematics
query_budget: each matching-channel callback, including zero flux; tested before query
row_budget: each positive propensity row; tested before row allocation
query_order: projectile input order, original per-cell target input order, original matching-channel input order
counter_meaning: permitted work prefix, not physical mutation; map comparator and arbitrary callback cost are not instruction-budgeted
resource_scope: limits include failure/abort policy; never partial physical input truncation
